title: Power Metal
tagline: Big melodies, heroic shapes and a bright, triumphant lift.
summary: Power metal takes the expressive scale of classic heavy rock and gives it a larger, more symphonic frame. It values clarity of melody, fast leads and dramatic phrasing over sheer darkness, often drawing from fantasy imagery and grand choruses. The genre is as much about uplift as about force.

pillars.name: Helloween
pillars.why: Helloween set a template for bright, agile melodies with a strong sense of chorus and arrangement.

pillars.name: Blind Guardian
pillars.why: Blind Guardian linked fast playing with epic themes and a strong narrative sense.

pillars.name: DragonForce
pillars.why: DragonForce pushed speed and keyboard textures into a highly visible, hook-heavy form.
